implementation_review.concurrent_linearization: During overlapping queries owner tuples and dirty queues are frozen. Different actor lanes update disjoint subscriber bits under the existing per-die mutex; canonical actor-order frames are a valid linearization. Pumps and installations remain outside joined query phases.
implementation_review.pump_termination: Drain every produced update before relaunch. Stop when an exhaustive bounded pass returns fewer than the output budget, including the no-eligible-subscriber case with other lanes still pending. An exactly full batch requires another call to prove the filtered tail empty. Check dirty-capacity growth and max-visits multiplication before narrowing to uint32.
implementation_review.frame_normalization: Pump frames use controller session in control_before/control_after and publisher completion word7; a previous-session control_before normalizes separately from current-session records. Ordinary new-owner completions use word7, whereas original receiver completions use word6. Raw update serial stays owner-global; logical delivery serial stays lane-local.
implementation_review.publication_binding: For each refresh key, require a one-to-one match of sorted raw hardware updates to the actual logical summary messages and receiver commands, allowing only the documented lane transport serial rewrite. Compare final registry bits with actual receiver-cache keys and require zero pending bits and empty dirty queues after final drain.
implementation_review.baseline_compatibility: Do not rewrite historical mode1 source manifests or claim push-mode byte equality for publication scan counters. New mode2 logs intentionally report zero host polling scans; all canonical route and consumed-value evidence still must match.
